title: Payment Policy heading
text: Payment Policy

title: Fees due rule
text: Fees are due promptly at the beginning of each session.

title: Special arrangement rule
text: If you need a special arrangement, come to the school and discuss it with the administrator or proprietress.

title: Unsettled fees rule
text: A child whose fees are still unsettled after written notice has been given will not be allowed to stay in school.

title: Bank payment rule
text: Pay fees directly at the bank. Never pay a teacher or any other unauthorised member of staff.

title: Policy disclaimer
text: The school will not take responsibility for any inconvenience that arises if this policy is not followed.
